justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's own gate.log names revision 95388a50, the tree and the command on its header lines and its summary line is '43 passed in 56.50s' with PYTEST_EXIT=0; ruff.log is 'All checks passed!' with RUFF_EXIT=0; negative_control.log reddens the suite (assert 17 == 1) when the rule's source_cocos is set to 17. Two gaps: the reviewed run recorded baseline_suite null and after_suite null, so added failures are not derivable from its own record and were measured here independently; and the gate log header records neither the map path nor module.__file__. The reviewed negative control fired at the reviewed identity assertion at tests/data/test_geqdsk_store.py:107, not at the numeric -2 pi check, so it proves the suite detects a wrong source_cocos rather than the size of the missing factor.
justifications.fit: the new module is a thin staging seam with named constants (GEQDSK_GROUP, PSI_ARRAY, R_ARRAY, Z_ARRAY, PSI_UNIT, GRID_UNIT) each carrying its reason, a module docstring that states the mechanism (the store keeps the source's COCOS 1 flux and defers the COCOS 1 -> 17 factor to the map rule), and no version, plan or ticket identifier in symbol names, filenames or comments. It follows imas_alambic.eddb's cache layout rather than inventing a second one.
justifications.goal_fidelity: plan section 7 for jtmm-geqdsk-psi-store names exactly this: stage E101011's G-EQDSK flux through a store the transform engine reads, bind it to equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_2d/psi with transformation=psi_like and source_cocos=1, and meet the psi check through the engine. imas_ambix/data/geqdsk_store.py:63 write_geqdsk_store writes {shot}.zarr/GEQDSK/PSI with a PSI_time sibling and GRID_R/GRID_Z. The map rule (maps/jt-60sa/maps/equilibrium.json semantic_id equilibrium_psi) carries GEQDSK/PSI -> equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_2d/psi, psi_like, source_cocos 1, and the test measures the rule's convention_factor as -2*pi. The served psi equals the G-EQDSK psi times -2 pi to NRMS under 1 percent (test_engine_psi_matches_the_geqdsk_flux_times_minus_two_pi), reproduced here by the after arm.
justifications.reuse: the module depends on the single G-EQDSK reader imas_ambix.challenge.loader.load_geqdsk (no second reader is written), reuses imas_alambic.eddb's write_channel, normalised_shot and UNIT_ATTR, ChannelRecord from imas_alambic.eddb_remote, and time_array_name / VirtualZarrView from imas_alambic, so the staged group reads through the same view as a fetched channel.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 9705265c..95388a50 is four paths, all inside the manifest's declared write paths: imas_ambix/data/geqdsk_store.py and tests/data/test_geqdsk_store.py (both new), tests/data/test_jt60sa_signal_maps.py, and the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-geqdsk-psi-store.html. The fifth declared write path, maps/jt-60sa/maps/equilibrium.json, is gitignored and carries the one psi rule the git diff cannot show. The manifest also declares packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/pulse_writer.py and tests/data/test_pulse_writer.py, neither touched and both dropped in the run's final message, so the declaration over-reaches the diff.
